_README: Source-backed earnings research. `normalizedEps` stores direct company-reported adjusted EPS by period, which is preferred when twelve contiguous months exist: quarters, half-years ("months": 6) or a mix, with "derived" naming the subtraction for a quarter the issuer never states alone; "ccy" is the issuer currency and is converted to the quote's (D70). Under `adjustments`, a directly stated `amountPerShare` may drive arithmetic. An absolute `amount` may do so only with `basis: after-tax attributable`; gross or pre-tax amounts stay as evidence with `arithmetic:false`.

HLN.L.note: Added 10 October 2026. Issuer pence are stored as GBP per ordinary share. Adjusted earnings exclude restructuring and other items; they are not independently reconstructed owner earnings. The derived H2 uses rounded annual less H1 EPS and may differ from a separately calculated half-year weighted-share result. Only one rolling twelve-month observation is established; no adjusted historical percentile is certified.

quarters.derived: FY2025 GBP0.188 less H1 2025 GBP0.092; both issuer figures rounded to 0.1p

PDD.note: Added by the 9 October 2026 deep dive. Issuer's non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS (1 ADS = 4 Class A ordinary shares), RMB, from each quarterly 6-K exhibit 99.1; non-GAAP is the issuer's own definition, set out in the reconciliation table of each release (share-based compensation is the main item). Four contiguous quarters, Q3 2025 to Q2 2026. Not independently reconstructed owner earnings. GAAP diluted EPS per ADS for the same quarters: 19.70, 16.51, 8.48, 18.45. FY2025 non-GAAP diluted EPS per ADS was RMB72.38 against GAAP RMB67.03.

STVN.note: Added 6 October 2026. Half-year and Q2 periods overlap and must not be summed. No twelve-month adjusted series or historical percentile is established.

CTEC.L.note: Added by the 5 October 2026 deep dive. Issuer states cents per share, stored here as USD per share. Two H1 observations alone do not establish twelve contiguous months; no research TTM or adjusted historical percentile is implied. The issuer cash conversion measures exclude growth capex and must not be described as cash after all reinvestment.

CME.note: Added by the 30 September 2026 deep dive. H2 2025 is derived from issuer FY2025 less H1 2025; H2 plus H1 2026 covers twelve contiguous months. Company-adjusted excludes investment gains as well as amortisation and other charges; it is not independently reconstructed owner earnings. Two annual comparatives do not certify the full historical percentile. H1 and Q2 entries overlap and must not be added together.

FUL.note: Q3 issuer reconciliation, using literal fiscal period ends. Reported Q3 2026 EPS is USD1.44; adjusted EPS is USD1.52. The reconciliation removes a USD19.713m unrealized acquisition-related FX-forward gain alongside expense and tax adjustments. The gross gain is evidence only, not an after-tax attributable adjustment. No matching FY2026 row exists in earnings.json, so no annual amount is assigned to an invented fiscal date. These two comparative quarters do not establish twelve contiguous months or an adjusted historical percentile. Source for the gain and EPS: https://investors.hbfuller.com/news/news-details/2026/H-B--Fuller-Reports-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx . Added by the 26 September 2026 deep dive.

NVO.note: Issuer Q2 2026 report, page 3 and Appendix 7. Adjusted EPS excludes specified intangible charges, major impairments/legal/restructuring items and 340B provision reversals with their related tax effects. H1 and Q2 overlap; never sum them. Only six months are covered, so these entries do not establish research TTM EPS or adjusted historical percentiles. DKK per ADR is explicitly the issuer unit, not USD. Added by the 25 September 2026 deep dive. 9 October 2026 deep dive: added FY2025 adjusted DKK26.17 from the Q4 2025 report and a derived H2 2025, so H2 2025 plus H1 2026 now covers twelve contiguous months. The derivation uses the H1 2025 comparative stored above (12.71, from the Q2 2026 report); a scout read H1 2025 as 12.68 in the same report's highlights, so the derived half carries about DKK0.03 of definitional uncertainty.

REL.L.note: Issuer H1 2026 release states adjusted EPS in pence: 68.6p for H1 2026 and 63.5p for H1 2025. Stored as GBP0.686 and GBP0.635, a unit scaling only, not FX conversion. The intervening H2 is not recorded here; no research TTM EPS or adjusted percentile is established. Added by the 25 September 2026 deep dive.

BVI.PA.basis: company-adjusted EPS (excludes amortisation of acquired intangibles, disposal results, restructuring and other adjustment items)
BVI.PA.note: Half-years only. H2 2025 is derived as FY2025 adjusted EPS less H1 2025 adjusted EPS, both issuer-stated. Company-adjusted, not GAAP and not independently reconstructed. Added by the 23 September 2026 19:18 deep dive.

RSGN.SW.note: H1 2025 comparative adjusted for the electrical switches and connectors business divested in December 2025. Basic EPS, not diluted or independently reconstructed owner earnings. One half-year only; no research TTM or adjusted historical percentile. Added by the 21 September 2026 deep dive.

LSEG.L.note: Direct issuer diluted adjusted EPS, not headline basic adjusted EPS. These two half-years are separated by the missing H2 2025 and must not be summed into TTM. Exclusions follow the issuer definition; this is not independently reconstructed owner earnings. Added by the 20 September 2026 deep dive.

BBW.note: H1 fiscal 2026 excludes a USD7m prior-cost IEEPA tariff refund, USD5.338m after tax in the issuer reconciliation. GAAP H1 EPS is USD2.16 versus adjusted USD1.73. The refund was recognized in the current half, not the historical year in which the tariff costs arose. No annual adjustment is assigned because the current fiscal-year-end row is not yet in earnings.json. Issuer period ends differ from Yahoo month-end labels; these are literal issuer dates. H1 and Q2 overlap and must not be added. No research TTM or adjusted historical percentile is established. Added by the 19 September 2026 deep dive.

YUMC.note: Issuer adjusted EPS equals GAAP EPS for these periods. It retains investment mark-to-market effects; do not describe it as owner earnings or as an independently normalized investment-income series. Q2 is contained within H1 and must not be added to it. Added by the 16 September 2026 deep dive.

TW.note: Tradeweb's non-GAAP definition. It excludes the Canton gains but also applies the company's stated acquisition, compensation, foreign-exchange, tax-receivable and share-basis adjustments; use it as a consistent company-adjusted comparison, not as GAAP or independently reconstructed owner earnings.

EXPN.L.note: Issuer values in USD per ordinary share, not GBp and not the headline basic Benchmark EPS. Annual evidence only. researchTtm currently assumes EPS already matches quote units and has no currency conversion, so do not populate USD quarters for this GBp listing until that consumer supports currency safely. Current proposal translates the local share price to USD and leaves filed EPS unchanged.

MWA.note: Direct issuer quarterly figures. Q3 FY2026 includes the separately recorded $0.06 one-time tax benefit and unquantified tariff benefits; company-adjusted does not mean one-off-free. Two nonconsecutive quarters do not establish research TTM EPS.

AZN.L.basis: company Core EPS per ordinary share, USD
AZN.L.note: Direct issuer periods, USD per ordinary share against a GBp quote (converted by fetch-prices, D70). H1 2026 and Q2 2026 are held; research TTM needs Q3 and Q4 2025 (Q3 derivable as 9M less H1) before it can form. Core EPS is not certified owner earnings. Update 14 September 2026, 22:47 UTC: the appended issuer Q3 and Q4 2025 periods now complete twelve months with H1 2026, superseding the earlier missing-period statement. Core EPS is the issuer basic ordinary-share basis; no research historical percentile is certified.

UNFI.note: Issuer reconciliation, including comparative periods. These adjustments do not certify owner earnings or an adjusted historical percentile. The two quarterly periods are not consecutive; no research TTM is established.

HLN.L.what: Net disposals and others benefit removed in the issuer reconciliation of IFRS profit attributable to shareholders to adjusted profit; aggregate category, not a pure operating disposal gain.

Net disposals and others benefit removed in the issuer reconciliation of IFRS profit attributable to shareholders to adjusted profit; aggregate category including tax effects. FY2025 EPS is absent locally, so no historical per-share adjustment is claimed in this run.

H1 2026 Maidenhead site-disposal gain netted within restructuring costs. Gross gain, not separately certified after-tax attributable income; evidence only. The cash-flow statement also records GBP21m property-sale proceeds, a separate cash measure, not an additional earnings adjustment.

H1 2026 net disposals and others benefit removed in the issuer attributable-profit reconciliation. This is the aggregate net after-tax benefit, not the separate GBP21m gross Maidenhead gain within restructuring; do not subtract the gross gain as well.

STVN.what: Q2 2026 loss on sale of Balda C. Brewer and related transaction costs, an expense rather than income to remove.
STVN.note: Evidence only: do not subtract this positive stored amount from earnings, or add it back independently of the direct company-adjusted EPS. Local Q2 opinc EUR51.282m differs from issuer reported EUR39.1m by approximately this charge; issuer reported operating profit controls the research comparison.

4543.T.what: Q1 FY ending March 2027 settlement gain of JPY20,110m in the bridge from reported to adjusted operating profit.
4543.T.note: Pre-tax operating item, not a certified after-tax attributable gain. Net non-recurring operating gains of JPY17,084m include other expenses and are not a second adjustment. No EPS deduction or annualised adjusted EPS is inferred.

CME.what: Q2 2026 unrealized and realized investment gains removed by the issuer reconciliation. Quarter-only evidence; H1's net investment category was a loss, so this must not be read as an annual gain.
CME.note: Pre-tax amount; retain as evidence and use direct company-adjusted EPS. FY2026 is not yet a filed annual row.

CME.what: Q2 2026 other income-tax benefits removed in the issuer reconciliation, related to state tax examinations and adjustments to tax reserves and receivables.
CME.note: Quarter-only consolidated reconciliation amount. Not separately certified attributable to common shareholders; no direct subtraction and no overlap with normalizedEps.CME.

CME.what: FY2025 net unrealized and realized investment gains removed in the issuer adjusted-income reconciliation; Q4 alone was USD349.8m. Full-year and quarterly amounts overlap and must not both be subtracted.
CME.note: Gross reconciliation category, not a separately stated after-tax attributable amount. Tax effects are supplied for the adjustment bundle. Evidence only; use normalizedEps.CME for the issuer adjusted basis.

BVI.PA.what: H1 2026 'other adjustment items', a net expense of EUR75.7m against net income of EUR21.6m in H1 2025. It includes net losses on disposals and acquisitions of EUR9.8m, restructuring of EUR9.6m and costs of the Government Services exit (a EUR32.0m provision for exit risks at 30 June 2026). This is why reported attributable profit fell 26.2% to EUR237.9m while adjusted EPS rose 4.8% to EUR0.68.
BVI.PA.note: Issuer press release as distributed on GlobeNewswire. This run could not confirm that the amount is after tax and attributable to shareholders, so it is evidence only. Use normalizedEps.BVI.PA for the adjusted denominator.

BVI.PA.what: H1 2025 comparative net gain in the issuer reconciliation line for disposals of businesses and other acquisition-related income and expenses. Appendix 6 of the H1 2026 release reports a EUR64.9m gain in this category; pre-tax evidence only.
BVI.PA.note: Matches local FY2025. Tax and minority effects are supplied for the aggregate adjustment bundle, not separately for this gain category. Do not subtract it from attributable earnings or overlap it with an aggregate adjustment. Existing H1 2026 expense evidence remains unchanged.

BVI.PA.what: FY2025 net gain in the issuer reconciliation category for disposals of businesses and other acquisition-related income and expenses, Appendix 6 of the FY2025 results release.
BVI.PA.note: Full-year pre-tax category overlaps the already recorded H1 2025 EUR64.9m gain; the two are not additive. Its separately after-tax attributable effect is not supplied. Evidence only: do not subtract from attributable EPS or overlap normalizedEps.BVI.PA. Existing evidence remains unchanged.

YUMC.what: FY2024 mark-to-market investment gain, stated as an eight-cent diluted EPS benefit in the FY2025 comparative release. Remove the sourced per-share gain only from the matching historical fiscal year; it is not an adjustment to current TTM EPS.

NKE.what: Q4 FY2026 diluted EPS benefit from expected recovery of IEEPA tariffs
NKE.note: Direct issuer per-share disclosure, not a tax estimate applied to the USD986m gross recovery. The disclosed benefit belongs to Q4; subtracting it from FY EPS is an approximate annual sensitivity because quarterly and annual weighted-average diluted shares differ. USD1.58 is not issuer-stated adjusted annual EPS. No adjusted historical percentile is established.

1038.HK.what: H1 2026 gain on disposal of the direct joint-venture interest in UK Power Networks, note 5
1038.HK.note: Consolidated gain before tax; not a separately stated after-tax attributable adjustment. This is only the direct UKPN gain, not all disposal income embedded in associates and joint ventures. Do not subtract it from EPS or annualise the prior half-year to invent continuing earnings. FY2026 has not yet been filed locally.

NFLX.what: Q1 2026 WBD merger termination fee received, recorded in Interest and other income (expense), note 6
NFLX.note: Cash receipt and pre-tax income, not a separately disclosed after-tax attributable EPS benefit. Yahoo trailing normEps of 3.177 is almost identical to reported EPS 3.18 despite this material receipt. Evidence only; do not use a guessed tax rate or share base to publish adjusted TTM or historical percentile. FY2026 is not yet filed locally.

TW.what: realised and unrealised gains on Canton Coin holdings, booked in Other income (loss), net — a non-operating line
TW.note: REFERENCE ONLY, superseded for arithmetic by normalizedEps.TW. The amount is company-stated PRE-TAX and before the Up-C allocation to non-controlling interests, so subtracting it from filed attributable net income removes more than the after-tax effect and produced a misleading 37.1x historical floor. The filed inputs remain useful evidence: FY2025 effective tax rate 21.6%, consolidated net income $921.500m and $812.792m attributable to Tradeweb Markets Inc. Yahoo's norm for FY2025 equals filed attributable income, so the vendor removed nothing.

TW.what: Q2 2026 unrealised gains on minority equity investments within Other income (loss), net; company-adjusted EPS excludes this line.
TW.note: Gross non-operating gain; no separately stated after-tax effect attributable to common shareholders. Recorded as evidence only, not subtracted from reported or vendor net income. The same quarter also had Canton-related losses, so this gross gain is not the net Other income line.

NVO.what: reversal of a US 340B Drug Pricing Program sales rebate provision (USD 4.2bn), booked in Q1 2026 as a reduction of cost of goods sold and an increase in reported net sales; non-cash, and excluded by the company from its own adjusted figures
NVO.note: REFERENCE ONLY. This is a pre-tax amount, so it cannot be subtracted directly from normalized EPS or after-tax attributable income. Novo guides a 21–23% effective rate for 2026, but applying a tax estimate would still be a reconstruction rather than the company's adjusted per-share result. Yahoo's norm for the Q1 2026 quarter equals filed ni exactly, so the vendor removed nothing. Going the other way in the same year, unrecorded here because the store only holds income to remove: DKK 6.3bn of non-cash pipeline impairments in Q2 2026, DKK 4.0bn of it monlunabant.

NVO.what: Q2 2025 US 340B sales-rebate provision reversal, identified in Appendix 7 of the Q2 2026 comparative reconciliation.
NVO.note: Separate from the already recorded DKK26.8bn Q1 2026 reversal. Gross revenue effect, not a separately certified after-tax attributable amount; evidence only.

MWA.what: one-time tax benefit from recognition of a loss on a foreign subsidiary investment, in the fiscal 2026 third quarter
MWA.note: Company's words: "The decrease in effective tax rate was primarily attributable to a one-time tax benefit resulting from the recognition of a loss on a foreign subsidiary investment, benefiting adjusted net income per diluted share by $0.06." Fiscal 2026 ends 30 September 2026 and is not yet a filed year in earnings.json, so this entry matches no row until the FY2026 accounts land. Recorded on the fourth attempt: the 8 September proposal found it, had nowhere to put it, and every run since re-derived it. The release quantifies no separate tariff-refund amount — it names tariff refunds only as one of several drivers of higher pricing — so no second entry is writable from it.

LULU.note: REFERENCE ONLY. The source states a gross refund and associated interest, not its after-tax effect attributable to common shareholders, so it cannot be subtracted directly from filed net income. Yahoo's norm for this year equals filed ni exactly, so the vendor removed nothing.

LULU.what: CORRECTION to the 8 September evidence: Q2 fiscal 2026 tariff refunds and associated interest contributed USD0.86 diluted EPS, net of tax. The filing places the benefit in the year ending 31 January 2027, not the earlier stored FY2026-01-31 row.
LULU.note: Issuer states fiscal year end and per-share after-tax benefit. Current-year evidence; that annual row is not filed locally yet. Source quarter ends 2 August 2026; Yahoo labels it 31 July. A quarterly EPS benefit is not an exact annual EPS restatement because weighted-average shares can differ. Prior gross evidence is retained and remains arithmetic:false.

EXPN.L.what: FY2026 profit on disposal of operations, principally EMEA and Asia Pacific subsidiaries.
EXPN.L.note: Gross gain in notes 9(b) and 17. No separately reconciled after-tax attributable amount; evidence only, not an EPS deduction.

EXPN.L.what: FY2026 gain from remeasurement of contingent consideration, deducted in the operating cash reconciliation.
EXPN.L.note: Gross non-cash gain in notes 17 and 21(c). No separately reconciled after-tax attributable amount; evidence only. Do not mix USD amounts with a GBp per-share denominator.

EXPN.L.what: FY2026 financing fair-value remeasurement gain, principally related to Brazilian intra-group funding; excluded in the issuer Benchmark earnings bridge.
EXPN.L.note: Reference only: consolidated financing gain, not a separately reconciled after-tax amount attributable to ordinary shareholders. Do not subtract a USD amount from a GBp per-share denominator. Direct annual Benchmark diluted EPS is stored separately; no adjusted historical percentile is certified.

AZN.L.what: H1 2026 gains on disposal of intangible assets, identified in the operating cash-flow reconciliation.
AZN.L.note: Gross gain; no separate after-tax attributable effect certified. FY2026 is not yet filed locally. Core earnings are not assumed to exclude this gain.

AZN.L.what: H1 2026 favourable fair-value movements on contingent consideration arising from business combinations, deducted in the operating cash-flow reconciliation.
AZN.L.note: Gross non-cash gain; no separate after-tax attributable effect certified. Evidence only, not a per-share deduction.

AZN.L.what: FY2025 gains on disposal of intangible assets
AZN.L.note: Gross cash-flow reconciliation item; no separately certified after-tax attributable effect. Evidence only. Core EPS is an issuer-defined basic per-ordinary-share measure, not diluted reported EPS.

AZN.L.what: FY2025 favourable fair-value movements on contingent consideration
AZN.L.note: Gross cash-flow reconciliation item; no separately certified after-tax attributable effect. Evidence only. Core EPS is an issuer-defined basic per-ordinary-share measure, not diluted reported EPS.

EUZ.DE.what: Q1 2025 extraordinary licensing revenue absent in H1 2026; the comparative H1 report separately describes EUR9m cash received after EUR1m Chinese withholding tax.
EUZ.DE.note: Revenue is not after-tax attributable income. The EUR5m revenue and EUR9m cash receipt are different accounting measures; do not subtract either from EPS or assume they are a reconciled profit adjustment.
